name: BETA Release
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - beta
  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  PACKAGE_NAME: "fm-localized"
  MS_URL: "https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=eliostruyf.vscode-\
    front-matter-beta"
  VSX_URL: "https://open-vsx.org/extension/eliostruyf/vscode-front-matter-beta"

jobs:
  localization:
    name: "Localization"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Localize the solution
        uses: ./.github/actions/localization
        with:
          TRANSLATION_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.TRANSLATION_API_KEY }}
          TRANSLATION_API_LOCATION: ${{ secrets.TRANSLATION_API_LOCATION }}
          TRANSLATION_API_URL: ${{ secrets.TRANSLATION_API_URL }}
          PACKAGE_NAME: ${{ env.PACKAGE_NAME }}

  release-ms:
    name: "Release to VSCode Marketplace"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: localization
    environment:
      name: "MS - BETA"
      url: ${{ env.MS_URL }}

    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ${{ env.PACKAGE_NAME }}

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org/
          cache: "npm"

      - name: Install the dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Prepare BETA
        run: node scripts/beta-release.js $GITHUB_RUN_ID

      - name: Publish
        run: npx @vscode/vsce publish -p ${{ secrets.VSCE_PAT }} --baseImagesUrl
          https://raw.githubusercontent.com/estruyf/vscode-front-matter/dev

      - name: Package VSIX
        run: npx @vscode/vsce package

      - name: Upload VSIX artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: vscode-demo-time-alpha.vsix
          path: "*.vsix"

  release-vsx:
    name: "Release to Open VSX"
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: localization
    environment:
      name: "Open VSX - BETA"
      url: ${{ env.VSX_URL }}

    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ${{ env.PACKAGE_NAME }}

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org/
          cache: "npm"

      - name: Install the dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Prepare BETA
        run: node scripts/beta-release.js $GITHUB_RUN_ID

      - name: Publish to open-vsx.org
        run: npx ovsx publish -p ${{ secrets.OPEN_VSX_PAT }}

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
